description: This file defines the implementation of DataElement and LinkedDataElement classes within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It includes a CRC32 checksum calculation method and buffer manipulation functions for linked data elements.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Class providing CRC32 checksum calculation for data buffers.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Class managing linked buffer segments with methods for buffer access, modification, and copying.

methods.name: uint32_t CRC32(const uint64_t offset,const uint64_t size) const
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified segment of the data buffer.

methods.name: void GetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,uint8_t * buffer) const
methods.description: Retrieves a segment of data from the buffer, handling boundary crossing via linked segments.

methods.name: void SetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,const uint8_t * buffer)
methods.description: Sets a segment of data into the buffer, handling boundary crossing via linked segments.

methods.name: uint64_t Copy(const uint64_t offset,const LinkedDataElement & copy)
methods.description: Copies data from another linked data element into this one starting at a specific offset.
